usage.result_excerpt:
I wrote `main.go`, but I haven't built or run it, so it's untested, including against your two examples.

It reads K from the first line, then splits the rest of the input into runs of ASCII letters and digits and lower-cases each one. It counts the words and sorts by count descending, then word ascending. It prints the first K as `word count`, or all of them if there are fewer than K.
